issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement's textual task description (problem_statement.md) states getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() should return a String formatted as "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)", but the UML diagram in the same problem_statement.md lists the method with return type void. The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) implements getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() returning String. The template (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) contains a TODO referencing this method but no implementation. This inconsistency between the UML (void) and both the textual description and solution (String) can confuse students about the correct method signature and may lead to implementing the wrong return type (causing compilation or test failures).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the problem statement consistent by updating the UML diagram entry for getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() to return String (change the UML line to: +getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String) so it matches the textual description and the solution. Alternatively, if UML is intended to be authoritative, change the textual description to explicitly state the method returns void and update the solution/template accordingly. Prefer updating the UML to String to align with the intended behavior shown in the solution and the exercise text.
